steps.name: When I send apply-action-code with oobCode "GARBAGE_E2E_INVALID_CODE_12345"
Then the response status should be 400

expected 400; response body: {"timestamp":"2026-10-26T07:34:02.204","status":400,"error":"Bad Request","message":"This link is invalid or has already been used","path":"/api/auth/firebase/apply-action-code","requestId":"REQ-e30a9973","messageKey":"error.auth.invalid_action_code"}
And the response messageKey should be "error.auth.invalid_action_code"
